Definition: Rekab, the name of two Arabs and of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Rechab = "rider"; n pr m; 1) father of Jehonadab in the time of king Jehu of the northern kingdom of Israel; 2) father of Malchijah, a leader of the district of Beth Haccerem and repairer of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; 3) one of the 2 captains whom Ishbosheth took into his service and who conspired to murder him; Rechabites = see Rechab "rider"; adj pr; 4) descendants of Rechab
